dynamic_require.description:
How the bundler treats a `require` whose argument isn't a string
literal: `"error"`, `"warn"` (default), or `"allow"`.

lua.description:
Dialect for `.lua` files (default `lua54`). Any dialect is accepted:
Roblox and Rojo trees that keep Luau in `.lua` files set
`"lua": "roblox"` or `"lua": "luau"`.

luau.description: Dialect for `.luau` files (default `luau`). Any dialect is accepted.

BlockNewlineGaps.description: Whether a block body can start or end with a blank line.

oneOf.description: Strip blank lines at the start and end of every block body.

Keep one blank line at the start or end of a block body when the source
has any there.

CallParentheses.description: When a call drops the parentheses around a lone string or table argument.

oneOf.description: Always use parentheses: `f("hello")`, `f({1, 2})`.
Omit parentheses for a single string argument: `f "hello"`.
Omit parentheses for a single table argument: `f {1, 2}`.
Omit parentheses for single string or table arguments.

Keep the source's choice: `f"x"` stays bare and `f("x")` keeps its
parentheses.

Category.description: A group of lint rules, enabled together through `categories`.

oneOf.description: Outright wrong or useless code.
Most likely wrong or useless.
Idiomatic code style.
Performance improvements.

CollapseSimpleStatement.description: Which simple single-statement blocks collapse onto one line.

oneOf.description: Always expand blocks.

Simple function bodies, as in `function() return x end`. The formatter
doesn't collapse function bodies, so this behaves like `never`.
Collapse simple conditionals: `if x then return y end`.

Simple functions and conditionals. The formatter doesn't collapse
function bodies, so this behaves like `conditional_only`.

DiagnosticSeverity.description:
Diagnostic severity: an `error` fails the run, a `warning` doesn't by
default.

DynamicRequire.description:
How the bundler treats a `require` whose argument isn't a string literal
and so can't be resolved at build time.

oneOf.description: Fail the bundle (E002).
Keep the call, resolving it at runtime, and warn (W007).

Keep the call without a warning, for trees where runtime requires are
normal, such as Roblox's `require(script.Parent.Child)`.

EntryConfig.description:
One entry of a multi-entry build: the file to bundle and where to write
the bundle, both relative to the `luck.json` directory.

block_newline_gaps.description:
Whether to keep a blank line at the start or end of a block body:
`"never"` (default) or `"preserve"`.

hexadecimal_case.description:
Case of the hex digits `A`-`F` in numeric literals: `"preserve"`
(default), `"lower"`, or `"upper"`. The `0x` prefix is always
lowercase.

magic_trailing_comma.description:
When true, a trailing comma in a table constructor breaks the table one
field per line, as in Black and Prettier. Defaults to `false`. Argument
lists can't carry one, since no dialect allows a comma after the last
argument.

sort_requires.description:
When true, sorts each run of consecutive `local NAME = require(...)`
or `local NAME = game:GetService(...)` statements by name. A blank
line ends a run.

space_after_function_names.description:
Where to put a space before `(`: `"never"` (default), `"definitions"`,
`"calls"`, or `"always"` for both.

HexCase.description:
Case of the hexadecimal digits `A`-`F` in numeric literals. The base
prefix (`0x`, `0b`) and exponent markers (`e`, `p`) are always lowercase,
so this setting only governs the digits.

oneOf.description: Leave the author's digit case untouched (`0xB0` and `0xb0` both stand).

categories.description:
Rule categories to enable on top of `correctness`, which is on by
default.

disable_default_rules.description:
When true, only rules set to `"enabled": true` in `rule_overrides` run.
Correctness rules and `categories` are ignored.

extra_globals.description: Extra global names to treat as defined, such as `vim` or `love`.

max_cyclomatic_complexity.description:
Complexity above which the `cyclomatic_complexity` rule, a `style`
rule, flags a function. The rule reports nothing while this is unset.

restricted_module_paths.description:
Modules the `restricted_module_paths` rule forbids requiring. A
trailing `.*` also covers submodules: `forbidden.*` matches `forbidden`
and `forbidden.sub`.

rule_overrides.description: Per-rule overrides, keyed by rule name.

ProfileOverrides.description:
A build profile, selected with `luck build --profile <name>`.

Its `minify` and `transforms` replace the top-level ones. `--release` and
`--dev` select the `release` and `dev` profiles.

oneOf.description: Always use double quotes.
Always use single quotes.

Use double quotes, switching to single when that needs strictly
fewer escaped quotes.

Use single quotes, switching to double when that needs strictly
fewer escaped quotes.

RuleSetting.description:
Overrides for one lint rule.

`enabled` turns the rule on or off, and `severity` replaces its default
severity. Either can be set alone.

SpaceAfterFunction.description: Where a space goes before the `(` of a function definition or call.

oneOf.description: No space: `function foo()`, `foo()`.
Space before a definition's parameter list only: `function foo ()`.
Space between a callee and its `(` only: `foo ()`.
Space in both definitions and calls.

TransformConfig.description:
Turns individual minifier passes on or off. Every pass except
`rename_globals` is on by default.

rename_globals.description:
Rename globals this file defines, such as `function helper() end` or
`counter = 0`. Off by default: renamed globals land under different
`_G` keys, which breaks other chunks, `_G["name"]` lookups, and loaded
strings that use the original names. Only takes effect with
`rename_locals` on.
